source.title: Experimental study of ignited unsteady hydrogen releases from a high pressure reservoir

eligibility.reason: The official pages expose publication metadata and figure-level descriptions, not a raw pressure-time archive; the digitized measured trace cannot support a trace-specific half-pressure endpoint.

claim_boundary: This recheck records public source access only; it does not validate the release model, replace the measured curve with the published calculated curve, or support safety-distance or ignition claims.
